commentary: Iron ore futures surged today. The most-traded contract I2501 ﬁnally closed at 707 yuan/mt, with a daily increase of 3.97%. Traders acƟvely sold their stocks; steel mills remained cauƟous and restocked as needed. The market trading atmosphere was average today. In Shandong, PB ﬁnes were traded at around 690-710 yuan/mt, up 10-20 yuan/mt from yesterday; in Tangshan, PB ﬁnes were traded at around 700-720 yuan/mt, up 10-15 yuan/mt from yesterday. Today's rebar apparent demand data showed a signiﬁcant increase, with a notable decline in the inventories of the ﬁve major steel products and a substanƟal rise in end-user demand. The overall market senƟment improved, driving ore prices sharply higher. Given that recent changes in steel mill proﬁts have been negligible and the blast furnace resumpƟon has been slow, there is insuﬃcient drive for further increases in ore prices and limited room for them to rise further.
